lines: {target}? Black stone and lava leave little mercy. I would write the warning down first.
If anyone heads for Basalt Deltas, tell them: Step like every block wants an argument. I will be at the lectern.
Ash and basalt make the Nether feel broken twice. I will write that warning down.
Basalt Deltas is no small story. Old stories usually leave out the screams.
I will remember Basalt Deltas as as jagged black country with heat in its cracks. I will write the warning larger than the wonder.
